## Workload

During the quarter, grader Marcus Bell completed 988 reads over 480 hours. This represents an average of 2.1 reads per hour. The workload was completed across the assigned review activity, with records processed consistently throughout the period. The volume of work provided a sufficient basis for review of both throughput and reading outcomes.

Reviewer Priya Anand considered the workload information and the associated quality findings. The review noted that the recorded activity was clearly documented and that the reported figures were internally consistent.

## Quality

A sample of 78 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement across the checked cases was 78.2. The findings indicate a generally reliable level of consistency, while also identifying scope for continued attention to cases requiring closer judgement.

Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent interpretation and decision-making. Priya Anand reviewed the results with Marcus Bell, and the comments were recorded for follow-up in routine practice.
